svg.aria-label: One bucket, kept on purpose, with its prune switched off: 1. Keep: Flux Kustomization volsync renders only backend/. Its name is part of the guard: a rename or re-path lets prune delete the Ceph bucket's contents. 2. Bucket: ObjectBucketClaim volsync on storage class ceph-bucket owns bucket volsync. Its reclaim policy is Delete, and prune is disabled on the claim. 3. User: CephObjectStoreUser volsync owns the bucket, with a 20G quota. Its prune is also disabled, and Git keeps it until expiry has run. 4. Keys: The PushSecret copies the bucket's access keys to 1Password item volsync-template, which also holds the repository passwords. 5. Freeze: Expiry of the retired repositories is not in force. Nothing here removes one. MinIO and R2 hold the other 21 and are not guarded by this Kustomization.
